narrativeVariants.flags.rebellion_salt_road_outcome == 'cr:
Recruitment drums answer each other across a market that has not forgotten the Salt Road. The notices promise wages, honor, and a swift campaign; the men reading them look hungry rather than proud. Ser Aldous Fenn is pinning one back up after someone tears it down.

@Aldous: I am being sent north. I would rather you heard it from me than from a list.

narrative: In the Capital, clerks read the names of the war dead beneath windows that will not stay shut. If Aldous's name is missing, it is because he stands at the back, ashamed to have survived it. Soldiers arrive coughing from the northern camps. No one calls it an omen yet.
